scope: CPU-only frozen-prediction rescoring on one official-reference panel; no inference, training, threshold changes, or model selection

metric_contract.pair_matching: strict zero-based inclusive exact pairs; no additional crossing/canonical/min-loop filtering
metric_contract.micro: pool TP/FP/FN; zero-denominator precision or recall=0
metric_contract.macro: unweighted mean per-sequence P/R/F1; P=R=F1=1 only when truth and prediction are both empty
metric_contract.ranking: micro-F1, full 5388 coverage only; descriptive audit, not model selection
metric_contract.paired_ci: 10000 paired sequence-level percentile bootstraps of macro-F1 delta versus xens2; seed 20261127
